text: Royal Bank of Canada's common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol RY.
short: Royal Bank of Canada is TSX/NYSE-listed (ticker RY).

source.name: Royal Bank of Canada Annual Report 2025 (consolidated financial statements)
source.quote: Our common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and New York Stock Exchange with the ticker symbol RY.

additionalSources.name: Royal Bank of Canada Annual Information Form dated December 2, 2025 (SEC Form 40-F Exhibit 1)
additionalSources.quote: The Bank's common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) in Canada and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in the U.S.
